title: What players can see: one page for the DM
summary: DMs have a new page that gathers every setting deciding what players see, with how many records are hidden, in one place.
items: Open it from Settings, Settings & Management → Players & permissions, the Features list or the command palette.
Simple switches, such as the black market, companion funds, map follow and the TV display, work right on the page. Each one also stays where it was.
Hidden NPCs, private maps, DM-only pins, hidden quest objectives, unidentified items and more show a count and a link to where you edit them.
Start the read-only preview as any player character from the same page.
Players never see this page or its counts.
